notes.title: UI and Postprocessing Update
notes.content: UI in the picture bool, store, and others have been updated to a better look. Bloom postprocessing has been added to some scenes for better looking game.

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.content: Achievements are finally here. Win the woman's affections and receive an achievement as a extra reward.

notes.title: Release update
notes.content:
Unfortunately steam is delaying the release of this game due to a realism in the game. I have had to update the game to address this issue then re-submit. I apologize for any delays. The game should be ready soon.
